Sleep forces Doze as soon as the screen turns off. Notifications and internet calls from apps such as WhatsApp and Telegram may be delayed. Regular calls and alarms still work. You can pause for one hour at any time.

Doze is Android\'s deep sleep state. Sleep enters it as soon as the screen turns off and leaves it when the screen turns on. Regular calls and alarms still wake the device. Internet calls and notifications may be delayed until Android opens a maintenance window.
